pages.title: Notiomastodon
pages.text: The Notiomastodon ($(o)Notiomastodon platensis$()) is an extinct gomphothere that lived across much of South America during the Pleistocene, disappearing at its end.$(br2)It was the most widespread proboscidean in South America, found from coastal lowlands to inland grasslands.$(br2)Notiomastodon was smaller than a modern elephant, with relatively short, upward-curving tusks, and fed on a mixed diet of grasses and browse.
